reader.requirement: At 1985, in an abbreviated combined relation condition a NOT whose next word is GREATER, >, LESS, <, EQUAL or = is part of the relational operator (and that negated operator is the one carried to later abbreviations); any other NOT (before IS, NOT, >=, <=, a bare object) is the logical operator, so the implied insertion yields a negated relation condition (GRL2.2).

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.Has(2002): at 85 every negatedAbbreviatedRelation binds as BoundNot of the abbreviated relation (logical NOT, stated operator carried); from 2002 an IS-led simple operator negates the operator instead
constructs abbreviated-not-logical-removed-2002 (85..2002) and abbreviated-not-is-simple-operator-removed-2014 (85..2014) via ConstructRegistry: admitted at 85, COBOL0902 at 2023

reader.edition-search: grep NegatedAbbreviat|abbreviated-not over src (non-generated); logicalNotBeforeRelationalOperator reads only token types, no edition
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 NOT before a non-operator word (IS, NOT, >=, <=) is a logical NOT and accepted; 2002 refuses the logical form and reads NOT IS-op as part of the operator; 2023 refuses both (COBOL0902)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: witnesses cover NOT NOT and printed operator sets; not NOT IS-op carry, NOT >=, NOT before a bare object with figurative/ALL literal, signed decimal operands

reader.notes: The parser predicate reads NOT by the token after it exactly per GRL2.1's six words; the binder's 85 arm wraps the abbreviated relation in a logical NOT and carries the stated operator. abnot2 at --std 2023 refuses NOT IS-op with COBOL0902, so the 85 arm is its own and correct.
reader.at-2023: NOT IS < and NOT IS > in abbreviated relations refused COBOL0902 (removed in 2014)

refuter.evidence: Probes refute-1985-238/rnot1.cob and rnot2.cob at --std 85 (runs/rnot1-001, runs/rnot2-001). rnot2 printed T3 FALSE (A > 5 AND NOT ZERO: figurative object after NOT read as logical NOT of A > ZERO, not a sign condition), T4 TRUE (NOT IS NOT < C OR D: logical NOT, IS NOT < carried), T5 TRUE (NOT EQUAL TO carried to D), T6 TRUE (arithmetic subject A + 1 with NOT IS GREATER THAN logical), T7 TRUE (NOT > with arithmetic-expression objects C - D and D * 2, carried), T8 FALSE / T9 TRUE (insertion restarts at the complete condition C > D, subject C carried, not A): each equals the GRL2.1/GRL2.2 expansion. rnot1 tried NOT GREATER THAN OR EQUAL TO C and NOT LESS THAN OR EQUAL TO C in an abbreviation: refused COBOL0001 at both. Under GRL2.1 the word after NOT is GREATER/LESS, so NOT joins the operator, giving NOT GREATER THAN OR EQUAL TO, which the 1985 relational-operator format does not print (IS [NOT] only on the six simple forms); refusal is consistent with the text. cite.py: OK  §1985:VI.6.3.3 GRL2.1 the text is in GRL2.1; OK  §1985:VI.6.3.1.1 the text is in the clause ('When used, NOT and the next key word or relation character are one relational operator').
